Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 126 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com .

Reddit’s KarmaLab is the creative engine behind the Global Sales Organization, helping brands show up on Reddit in ways that feel authentic to the platform while driving real business impact. As Reddit’s in-house creative strategy team, KarmaLab partners closely with Sales, Marketing, Product, and advertisers to develop campaigns, creative strategies, and storytelling that connect brands with Reddit communities.

Reddit is seeking a Creative Technologist to join KarmaLab and sit at the center of our AI-powered creative production, turning Reddit’s community insights and tools into scalable workflows that help teams go from a brief to client-ready ideas, assets, and reports.

As advertisers increasingly adopt generative tools, you’ll help ensure Reddit’s AI-generated creative assets are high-quality, brand-safe, and grounded in real community behavior. You’ll partner closely with Product, Engineering, and Reddit’s AI Strategy function to improve agentic workflows in Ads Manager, guide model outputs, and reduce the manual “glue work” required from strategists today.

Location: Hybrid - New York or Chicago

· Build and scale AI-powered creative workflows that connect Reddit’s data infrastructure, creative systems, and advertising ecosystem

· Improve and optimize LLM outputs across use cases, including creative tagging, asset generation, reporting, and end-to-end creative system design

· Develop frameworks for evaluating prompts, model outputs, and agentic AI workflows to support scalable production use cases

· Test and operationalize agentic AI frameworks and multi-agent systems that automate creative analysis, reporting, and asset generation

· Partner with Product and Engineering to build stakeholder-facing applications, dashboards, and tools that surface actionable creative insights and Reddit-native recommendations

· Automate and streamline creative reporting, workflows, and other manual processes across KarmaLab and the broader business

· 5–8+ years of professional experience across AI, data, creative strategy, or creative technology

· Experience using AI to transform workflows, build tooling, or scale creative systems

· Strong understanding of cultural insights, brand strategy, consumer behavior, or agency planning

· Advanced SQL skills and experience working with databases such as BigQuery

· Experience building or maintaining data pipelines and API integrations

· Experience developing frameworks for optimizing and evaluating LLM outputs

· Familiarity with agentic AI systems, multi-agent orchestration, or AI workflow automation

· Experience building dashboards or data visualization tools using platforms like Looker or Hex

· Comfortable operating in fast-moving, ambiguous, experimental environments

· Collaborative, builder-oriented mindset with a strong bias toward execution

· Comprehensive Healthcare Benefits and Income Replacement Programs

· 401k with Employer Match

· Global Benefit programs that fit your lifestyle, from workspace to professional development to caregiving support

· Family Planning Support

· Gender-Affirming Care

· Mental Health & Coaching Benefits

· Flexible Vacation & Paid Volunteer Time Off

· Generous Paid Parental Leave

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and will also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/ .

To provide greater transparency to candidates, we share base salary ranges for all US-based job postings regardless of state. We set standard base pay ranges for all roles based on function, level, and country location, benchmarked against similar stage growth companies. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including, skills, depth of work experience and relevant licenses/credentials, and may vary from the amounts listed below.

In select roles and locations, the interviews will be recorded, transcribed and summarized by artificial intelligence (AI). You will have the opportunity to opt out of recording, transcription and summarization prior to any scheduled interviews.

During the interview, we will collect the following categories of personal information: Identifiers, Professional and Employment-Related Information, Sensory Information (audio/video recording), and any other categories of personal information you choose to share with us.

We will use this information to evaluate your application for employment or an independent contractor role, as applicable. We will not sell your personal information or disclose it to any third party for their marketing purposes. We will delete any recording of your interview promptly after making a hiring decision.

For more information about how we will handle your personal information, including our retention of it, please refer to our Candidate Privacy Policy for Potential Employees and Contractors .

Reddit is proud to be an equal opportunity employer, and is committed to building a workforce representative of the diverse communities we serve. Reddit is committed to providing reasonable accommodations for qualified individuals with disabilities and disabled veterans in our job application procedures. If, due to a disability, you need an accommodation during the interview process, please let your recruiter know.

As an Associate Creative Engineer, you are skilled in digital design at high scale. You will work with an amazing team of creatives to make sure that artwork is designed at scale according to our client’s brand guidelines. You will take design briefs and key art from the account and creative team, ensuring conceptual creative ideas are designed at scale for digital delivery to market.

You are an ideal candidate if you come from an advertising agency or production design studio and have worked on a range of creative projects from marketing collateral, digital campaigns, print work, brand work, ads, and more.

This position requires full on-site attendance, five days per week , at the Barreal office (Heredia, Zona Franca Metropolitana).

You will

· Work with internal teams, account and creative to ensure continuity of delivery of final files within agreed timeframes and to high standards.

· Design to pixel-perfection and translate key art into the various resizes and versions required by the digital media buy.

· Become fully ingrained into the brand’s design templates and  acting as gatekeeper of brand guidelines. 

· Have an understanding of technical limitations that may affect what can be achieved creatively in various media types

· Build clean creative files to help manifest the development of a working framework

· Stay up to date on best digital practices for various platforms

· Help create a detailed template guide to clearly communicate the workings of the system

You have

· Experience working as a production designer or designer who thrives in high scale output, in an advertising agency, print or design studio.

· Experience withhigh-volume design

· Experienced with Adobe Creative Suite

· Working knowledge of motion design in Premiere/After Effects is an asset.

· Working knowledge of Figma/Sketch is an asset.

· Working knowledge of building and editing Keynote & PowerPoint decks

· A hands-on, execution driven attitude, turning vision into reality

· Strong attention to detail

· Problem solving mindset

· Maternity and parental leave extra days

· Competitive benefits packages

· Vacation, compassionate leave, sick days, and flex days

· Access to online services for families and new parents

· Diversity and Inclusion Board with 12 affinity groups

· Internal learning and development programs

· Enterprise-wide employee discounts

· And more…

As a Senior Creative Engineer , you are a seasoned professional in digital design and creative production at scale. You will work with an amazing team of creatives to ensure artwork is designed and adapted according to our client’s brand guidelines while maintaining the highest quality standards. You will take design briefs and key art from the account and creative team, ensuring conceptual creative ideas are translated into scalable digital assets ready for market.

You are an ideal candidate if you come from an advertising agency or production design studio and have worked across a variety of creative projects including digital campaigns, marketing collateral, motion graphics, brand work, advertising, and high-volume production.

You enjoy building scalable design systems, creating templates, mentoring others, and continuously improving creative workflows. You are adaptable, eager to learn new technologies and automation tools, and thrive in fast-paced environments.

· Collaborate with the Creative Team to bring their ideas to life while ensuring best practices and brand standards remain top of mind.

· Design and adapt key art into pixel-perfect digital assets across multiple formats, sizes, and platforms.

· Create and maintain scalable templates and design systems to support high-volume creative production.

· Produce high-quality motion graphics and animated assets for digital campaigns.

· Bring forward ideas to improve the team’s systems, templates, automation, and creative production workflows.

· Work with internal teams, Account, and Creative to ensure continuity of delivery of final files within agreed timeframes and to high standards.

· Become fully ingrained in the brand’s design systems and act as a gatekeeper of brand guidelines.

· Mentor junior and mid-level Creative Engineers, supporting their technical and production design development while fostering collaboration and team growth.

· Understand technical limitations across digital platforms and recommend creative solutions that maximize design quality and platform performance.

· Build clean, organized creative files that support scalable production and future campaign adaptations.

· Create detailed documentation and template guides to clearly communicate production workflows and design systems.

· Stay up to date on digital production best practices, motion design trends, creative technologies, and automation tools.

· Demonstrate adaptability and a continuous learning mindset while embracing new tools and evolving production processes.

· 3–5 years of experience working as a Production Designer, Designer, Motion Designer, or Creative Engineer in an advertising agency, production studio, or design environment.

· Extensive experience working within high-volume, high-scale creative production workflows.

· Strong experience building and maintaining design systems, templates, and scalable creative assets.

· Advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite, including After Effects for motion design.

· Strong motion design and animation skills.

· Advanced proficiency in Figma (Sketch experience is a plus).

· Experience with, or willingness to learn, creative automation platforms such as Celtra or Orca Plus .

· Experience building and editing Keynote and PowerPoint presentations.

· A collaborative mindset with the ability to mentor and develop junior team members.

· Pixel-perfect attention to detail with a strong commitment to quality assurance.

· Expertise in layout production, image optimization, static and animated digital advertising, email production, and visual guidelines.

· General understanding of HTML5.

· Strong problem-solving skills, adaptability, and the ability to quickly learn new tools and technologies.

· Maternity and parental leave extra days

· Competitive benefits packages

· Vacation, compassionate leave, sick days, and flex days

· Access to online services for families and new parents

· Diversity and Inclusion Board with 12 affinity groups

· Internal learning and development programs

· Enterprise-wide employee discounts

· And more…
